name: Would You Rather for Nurses Question Book
seoTitle: Would You Rather Book for Nurses
metaDescription: A Would You Rather book with 175 funny, snarky questions written for nurses. A fun way to pass a slow night shift or liven up a break room or party.
summary: 175 funny and thoughtful Would You Rather questions made for nurses. Great for slow night shifts, break room laughs, and nurse friend game nights.
whyItWorks: Few things bond a unit like a quiet stretch at 3 a.m., when everyone is caught up on charting and someone needs a reason to laugh. A book of Would You Rather questions written specifically for nurses fills that gap. The questions can be read aloud in a couple of minutes, so it works between call lights and during short breaks, and nobody needs to keep score.

It also travels well beyond the hospital. Bring it to a nursing school study group that needs a break from pharmacology, a bachelorette party for a nurse, or a holiday dinner with a table full of healthcare workers. The mix of snarky and thought provoking prompts, as the title describes, means it can get silly or surprisingly honest depending on the crowd. Because it is a paperback that fits in a bag, it makes a fun stocking stuffer or an add on to a bigger gift basket.
goodToKnow: The title describes 175 questions, so it lasts through plenty of breaks.
Humor is described as snarky, so preview sample pages on the listing if the group is easily offended.
Budget friendly and light, which makes it an easy add on to a larger gift.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for a whole unit?
faq.a: Yes, it works well left in the break room where everyone can use it. One copy can entertain a whole shift.
Students who have done clinical rotations will get most of the jokes. It is a fun pick for a study group or a graduation party.
